title: 2048 MERGE PUZZLE
shortDesc: 2048 Merge combines physics-based drop mechanics with classic 2048 arithmetic synthesis.
description: 2048 Merge is a dynamic drop-and-merge puzzle that combines physics-based ball dropping with 2048 arithmetic strategy. Drop matching numbered balls together to merge them into larger values and reach the ultimate 2048 tile.
instructions: Tap, drag, and release to drop numbered spheres into the container. Merge two spheres of identical value to double their number and trigger combo reactions.

faqs.a: Aim and drop numbered balls from the top of the container. When two balls of the same number collide, they merge into the next higher value (2+2=4, 4+4=8, up to 2048).

faqs.q: What happens if the container overflows?
faqs.a: If the balls stack past the top danger line for too long, the round ends. Keep combining matching numbers to keep space open.

faqs.q: Can I play 2048 Merge on mobile phones?
faqs.a: Yes! The game features responsive touch controls where you can drag and tap anywhere to aim and drop your balls.
